label: HTML
blurb: Arbitrary HTML/CSS/JS in a sandboxed frame — a bespoke widget. No network access.

controls.label: Reload
controls.title: Reload the frame from the stored HTML

controls.label: Show source

notes: sandbox="allow-scripts" with connect-src ’none’: anything local, nothing over the network.
PREFER `ui` unless the INTERACTION is the point.
An html BLOCK inside a stack renders like any other block; its persisted state lives at blocks[].state.data, not the tab’s own state.data.
